item.title: Canada expects strong investment interest from domestic pension funds in country's airports
item.description: Canada's transport minister said on Tuesday he expects strong interest from Canadian pension funds and possible participation from Australians, as the country opens its four largest airports to private investment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's transport minister said on Tuesday he expects strong interest from Canadian pension funds and possible participation from Australians, as the country opens its four largest airports to private investment. “We anticipate a very, very strong Canadian presence in these concession agreements,” Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon told Reuters in an interview. "The Canadian investors, notably pension plans, have made it known over the years that they’ve become very good at this sort of investment in other jurisdictions." Earlier, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government was seeking private investment through long-term concessions to operate airports in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and Calgary as part of a [USN:L1N4570FS TEXT:"campaign to boost"] the economy. The move would not open the door to a sale or change in public ownership. Carney said investors would not have to be "strictly" from Canada and there would be a competition. MacKinnon added that foreign investment approvals and national security tests would be part of any deal. Infrastructure companies, seeing strong, long-term demand for air travel, are investing billions of dollars in revamping airport terminals in countries like the [USN:L1N3XA0SP TEXT:"United States"] and Australia. Australia's Macquarie Asset Management (MQG.AX) , which has invested in a new airport terminal south of Montreal, sees "significant potential for further investment" in Canada's transportation infrastructure sector, said Karl Kuchel, the company's head of infrastructure in the Americas. Opportunities in that transport space "have been relatively limited in recent years compared to other infrastructure sectors," he added. Spokespeople from Canadian pension fund La Caisse and Australia's IFM Investors both said they see opportunity from the announcement. MacKinnon said it was fair to say that "Australian investors who invest around the world and who welcome Canadian investment in their country in infrastructure and in other things would be eligible investors." Carney's plan has drawn criticism from labour groups who warn that private investment in airports has led to higher costs for passengers. “Private investors don’t put billions into airports unless they expect to make billions back," said Lily Chang, secretary-treasurer of the Canadian Labour Congress. MacKinnon said Canada would learn from the experience of other countries. “We are far from the first movers on this," he said. "So we’ll want to follow the best practices that we’ve observed in conducting an open, fair process and one that certainly opens the door wide to Canadian investment in these facilities.”

item.title: Peso mexicano cae a menor nivel en seis semanas, en espera anuncio Fed
item.description: El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes a niveles no vistos desde inicios de agosto, presionado por un fortalecimiento global del dólar, ante expectativas de que la Reserva Federal (Fed) de Estados Unidos eleve las tasas de interés el miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes a niveles no vistos desde inicios de agosto, presionado por un [USN:L6N45717I TEXT:"fortalecimiento global del dólar"], ante expectativas de que la [USN:L6N4560R2 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] (Fed) de Estados Unidos eleve las tasas de interés el miércoles. La cautela también afectó a la bolsa local, debido a las tensiones en [USN:L6N45710T TEXT:"Medio Oriente"] tras ataques contra infraestructura energética saudí que dejaron fuera de servicio el oleoducto Este-Oeste y avivaron temores de que una reparación prolongada afecte el suministro y eleve los precios del petróleo. * La moneda local cotizaba en 17.1440 unidades en la recta final de los negocios, con una depreciación marginal de 0.06 a medida que los [USN:L6N457141 TEXT:"precios del crudo"] subieron más de 3 dólares, reavivando preocupaciones sobre la inflación mundial. * Durante el día, el peso llegó a debilitarse hasta 17.1950 por dólar, un nivel no visto desde el 7 de agosto. * Los inversionistas apuestan a que la Fed aumente el miércoles su tasa de referencia en [USN:L6N4560R2 TEXT:"25 puntos básicos"] y que realice otro ajuste más adelante. * Un alza de tasas en Estados Unidos restaría atractivo a los activos mexicanos al reducir el diferencial de rendimientos frente a los instrumentos estadounidenses. El mercado espera que [USN:L1N4510I3 TEXT:"Banco de México"] mantenga sin cambios su tasa clave durante un periodo prolongado. * La bolsa mexicana también terminó con pérdidas, afectada por la cautela previa al anuncio de la Fed y un feriado local del miércoles. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) descendió 1.11% a 63,507.11 puntos, su nivel más bajo de cierre en lo que va del año. * Las acciones del gigante de medios Grupo Televisa (TLEVISACPO.MX) encabezaron las bajas, con una disminución de 4.63%, seguidas por los títulos de la minera Industrias Peñoles (PEOLES.MX) , que restaron 3.06%. * En contraste, los papeles de la firma de logística y transporte Grupo Traxión (TRAXIONA.MX) se dispararon 13.85 % tras conocerse los planes de lanzar una oferta pública de adquisición por la totalidad de sus acciones. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años terminó la jornada en 9.52%, mientras que la tasa del instrumento a 20 años cerró en 10.02%.

item.title: Petróleo fecha com alta de US$3 com interrupção em Yanbu e cancelamentos de cargas sauditas
item.description: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de US$3 nesta terça-feira, depois que fontes do setor de transporte marítimo informaram que os embarques de petróleo no centro de exportação de Yanbu, na Arábia Saudita, no Mar Vermelho, haviam sido suspensos e que Riade havia cancelado algumas entregas de cargas a clientes europeus.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de US$3 nesta terça-feira, depois que fontes do setor de transporte marítimo informaram que os embarques de petróleo no centro de exportação de Yanbu, na Arábia Saudita, no Mar Vermelho, haviam sido suspensos e que Riade havia cancelado algumas entregas de cargas a clientes europeus. Os novos acontecimentos aprofundaram as preocupações de que as interrupções em uma rota crítica de exportação de petróleo pudessem persistir por semanas. Os ganhos nos futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos superaram os do Brent nesta terça-feira, à medida que os temores de que os problemas de abastecimento da Arábia Saudita estivessem se ampliando levaram os investidores a buscar o petróleo dos EUA como alternativa. O Brent fechou com alta de US$3,07, ou 2,9%, a US$108,75 por barril, enquanto o WTI fechou com alta de US$4,44, ou 4,38%, a US$105,83 por barril. Ambos os contratos fecharam em seu nível mais alto desde 19 de maio. O porto de Yanbu assumiu uma importância extraordinária para o abastecimento global desde que a guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã causou o fechamento do Estreito de Ormuz, uma via navegável crucial que era o canal por onde passava um quinto dos suprimentos mundiais de petróleo e gás natural liquefeito. A guerra forçou a Arábia Saudita a redirecionar o petróleo para o oeste por meio do oleoduto Leste-Oeste, de aproximadamente 1.200 quilômetros, que transporta petróleo do leste até Yanbu, na costa oeste, permitindo que as exportações saiam pelo Mar Vermelho sem que os petroleiros precisem passar pelo estreito. No entanto, os ataques ao oleoduto Leste-Oeste, perpetrados na sexta-feira pelos houthis do Iêmen — alinhados com o Irã —, forçaram o reino, maior exportador mundial de petróleo, a fechar essa importante rota de exportação. As preocupações com o abastecimento se intensificaram depois que as forças houthis lançaram novos ataques contra a Arábia Saudita na segunda-feira, enquanto os países árabes do Golfo Pérsico adiaram as discussões planejadas com o Irã. Nesta terça-feira, fontes do setor de transporte marítimo informaram à Reuters que os carregamentos de petróleo no terminal de exportação da Arábia Saudita no Mar Vermelho, em Yanbu, haviam sido suspensos. A notícia veio depois que fontes afirmaram que Riade havia informado aos clientes europeus que alguns carregamentos de petróleo previstos para o final de setembro seriam cancelados. Andy Lipow, presidente da Lipow Oil Associates, disse que o cancelamento de alguns embarques de petróleo saudita para a Europa reforçou as expectativas de que as refinarias europeias recorrerão aos suprimentos dos EUA, ajudando a elevar o WTI em relação ao Brent. Os operadores têm comprado contratos futuros do WTI apostando que as interrupções nas exportações sauditas durarão mais do que o esperado, disse Lipow. Como as refinarias americanas podem alternar facilmente entre os tipos de petróleo, a demanda por petróleo “doce”, como o WTI, poderia aumentar, dando ainda mais suporte aos preços, acrescentou ele.

item.title: Senado EEUU no logra sacar adelante proyecto de ley sobre criptomonedas, en revés para el sector
item.description: El Senado de Estados Unidos no logró sacar adelante el martes una ley integral sobre criptomonedas respaldada por el presidente Donald Trump, lo que supuso un duro golpe para las empresas de activos digitales y para los republicanos que habían defendido el proyecto durante meses.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Lang
item.content:encoded: El Senado de Estados Unidos no logró sacar adelante el martes una ley integral sobre criptomonedas respaldada por el presidente Donald Trump, lo que supuso un duro golpe para las empresas de activos digitales y para los republicanos que habían defendido el proyecto durante meses. El proyecto de ley, denominado "Clarity Act", no logró los 60 votos necesarios para sacar adelante la mayoría de las leyes en la cámara de 100 escaños, ya que cuatro senadores republicanos se unieron a todos los demócratas para votar en contra. La votación ha dejado de hecho el proyecto de ley en suspenso, ya que el Congreso tiene previsto abandonar Washington este mes de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre, en las que los republicanos luchan por mantener el control de la Cámara de Representantes y el Senado. El proyecto tenía como objetivo crear un marco regulador para los activos digitales, lo que, según las empresas de criptomonedas, les proporcionaría una base jurídica más sólida. Este sector, que cuenta con grandes recursos económicos, invirtió cientos de millones de dólares en campañas para impulsar el proyecto de ley. Trump, que ha ganado más de 1.400 millones de dólares con las inversiones en criptomonedas de su familia, había instado al Congreso a aprobarla. Trump buscó financiación del sector de las criptomonedas durante la campaña electoral de 2024, autodenominándose "presidente de las criptomonedas". Los organismos reguladores, en particular la Comisión de Valores y Bolsa (SEC) y la Comisión de Comercio de Futuros de Materias Primas (CFTC), estarán ahora en condiciones de llenar el vacío normativo en materia de criptomonedas, pero los esfuerzos por elaborar normas favorables para el sector de los activos digitales podrían resultar complicados. Los expertos del sector han señalado que solamente el Congreso puede crear un marco regulador duradero. Sin legislación, las normativas serán vulnerables a los cambios en el clima político y a los recursos judiciales, lo que generará riesgos persistentes para el sector de las criptomonedas, según ejecutivos y analistas. El bitcóin, la mayor criptomoneda del mundo, cayó más de un 5% cuando parecía que la votación iba a fracasar, lo que supone su mayor baja porcentual diaria desde junio. Las acciones de la plataforma de intercambio de criptomonedas Coinbase (COIN.O) y del emisor de stablecoins Circle (CRCL.N) se hundieron hasta un 10%.

item.title: JPMorgan expects investment banking, trading to shine in third quarter
item.description: JPMorgan Chase expects investment banking fees and trading revenue growth to be strong in the third quarter, co-President Doug Petno said at an investor conference on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Arasu Basil, Nupur Anand
item.content:encoded: JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) expects investment banking fees and trading revenue growth to be strong in the third quarter, co-President Doug Petno said at an investor conference on Tuesday. Shares of the largest U.S. lender erased earlier losses and closed up about 0.7%, as the comments calmed some nerves after Bank of America's (BAC.N) [USN:L1N4560P2 TEXT:"weak forecast"] on Monday triggered a selloff in U.S. big bank stocks. Speaking at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference, Petno said investment banking fees and markets revenue were expected to be up "mid-to-high teens" percentage in the third quarter. Deal activity is robust and JPMorgan was seeing broad-based strength in investment banking and markets businesses, Petno said. "We started this quarter with a strong pipeline that continues. I touched on management and board confidence-that's driving tremendous amount of M&A activity. It's as high as we've seen in some time," he said. JPMorgan's investment banking fees [USN:L4N43G0YE TEXT:"jumped 30% in the second quarter"] from a year ago, while markets revenue surged 35%. Clients are incredibly resilient and seeing through the market volatility and the fog of uncertainty, which reflects the diversity and strength of the U.S. economy, Petno said. Wall Street is closely watching the industry conference for commentary on deal pipelines and updates on consumer health from major U.S. banks. Asked about JPMorgan doing acquisitions, Petno said the bank was in the market constantly, but the bar is "very high" for inorganic opportunities. "We are ready to opportunistically acquire. We have sort of a shopping list if it makes sense, but at the right valuation if there's a market disruption," Petno said. JAMIE DIMON IS NOT STEPPING BACK In June, JPMorgan [USN:L4N42X15F TEXT:"elevated insiders"] Petno and Troy Rohrbaugh to co-presidents as the bank reshuffled its top ranks to set up a [USN:L1N4310KF TEXT:"new succession plan"]. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon is not stepping back, Petno said, adding he was active as ever and out in the market all the time. "The company is big. We're scaling rapidly. We have big, big plans, big ambitions. So there's a lot for Troy and I to do to give him leverage to round us out as executives," Petno said. Petno and Rohrbaugh were previously co-CEOs of the commercial and investment bank at JPMorgan. "We had a very high-functioning partnership as co-heads of CIB. Mobility is a fantastic thing when you move lift somebody up and move them around the company," Petno said.

item.title: World Bank's IDA prices $3 billion bond, first after SEC waiver
item.description: The World Bank's International Development Association priced a $3 billion bond from an order book of nearly $8 billion, a source familiar with the transaction said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The World Bank's International Development Association priced a $3 billion bond from an order book of nearly $8 billion, a source familiar with the transaction said on Tuesday. The Global Sustainable Development Bond is scheduled to settle on September 25, 2026, and mature on September 25, 2031. It carries a 4.875% coupon, the source said The transaction was led by Bank of America, BMO Capital Markets, Citi and JPMorgan, according to the source The deal marks IDA's first U.S. dollar issuance since it received an exemption from U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing requirements The SEC exemption brings IDA in line with other multilateral development banks, allowing the World Bank's concessional lending arm to raise funds in U.S. markets more cheaply and efficiently An SEC exemption allows an issuer's bonds to be treated as exempt securities under U.S. securities laws, reducing registration requirements and making it easier and cheaper to access U.S. capital markets.

item.title: Produção de aço do Brasil cai 6,2% em agosto sobre um ano antes
item.description: As siderúrgicas brasileiras produziram 2,69 milhões de toneladas de aço bruto em agosto, uma queda de 6,2% sobre o volume produzido um ano antes, segundo dados apresentados nesta terça-feira pela associação que reúne as usinas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As siderúrgicas brasileiras produziram 2,69 milhões de toneladas de aço bruto em agosto, uma queda de 6,2% sobre o volume produzido um ano antes, segundo dados apresentados nesta terça-feira pela associação que reúne as usinas. A queda ocorreu apesar de crescimento nas vendas no mercado interno e nas exportações, segundo os dados do Aço Brasil. No mercado interno, as usinas venderam 1,8% mais no período, para 1,86 milhão de toneladas, ao passo que as exportações subiram 13%, a 959 mil toneladas. O recuo na produção ocorreu, inclusive, com baixa nas importações, de 19,5% no período, para 395 mil toneladas.

item.title: Rahimi brothers strike as Al-Ain hand Al-Nassr Asian Champions League thumping
item.description: Saudi Pro League champions Al-Nassr suffered a 4-0 thumping at the hands of Al-Ain in the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday as Cristiano Ronaldo and his team mates made the worst possible start to their Asian Champions League Elite challenge.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Saudi Pro League champions Al-Nassr suffered a 4-0 thumping at the hands of Al-Ain in the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday as Cristiano Ronaldo and his team mates made the worst possible start to their Asian Champions League Elite challenge. Houssine Rahimi scored twice to put the former champions in command of the tie before his elder brother Soufiane hit their team's third and Giorgos Giakoumakis scored their fourth in the 85th minute. "We knew it was going to be tough, we had to give it our all and I think we did that," said Giakoumakis. "We were really mature from the first to the last moment and we managed to score a good amount of goals and have a good victory." Al-Ain went in front in the 25th minute when Houssine Rahimi pounced on Saad Al-Nasser's under-hit back-pass to slot through Nawaf Al-Aqidi's legs and he doubled the lead when he side-footed home from eight yards in the 63rd minute. Soufiane Rahimi added the third when he judged his run onto Alejandro Romero's through ball into the penalty area to perfection, remaining onside to drive his first-time shot into the bottom corner. Giakoumakis netted the fourth as Soufiane Rahimi turned provider, rolling the ball into the path of the Greek forward 15 yards from goal and he gleefully converted. Al-Hilal registered a 2-1 win over Qatar's Al-Gharafa in their league phase opener with a goal in each half from Ruben Neves and Sergej Milinkovic-Savic in Riyadh after both sides had been reduced to 10 men. Crysencio Summerville was sent off after a 32nd-minute altercation with Abdulrahman Al-Rashidi and, following the resulting melee, Al-Gharafa's Ismael Bennacer was also dismissed by referee Omar Al-Ali. The four-times champions from Saudi Arabia went ahead three minutes into first-half stoppage time through Neves' penalty, with the spot-kick awarded when Al-Rashidi hauled winger Saimon Bouabre down inside the area. Milinkovic-Savic doubled Al-Hilal's lead 17 minutes from time when his header was deflected past goalkeeper Ahmed Kone and that was to prove crucial as Alaa Eddin Hasan scored for the visitors from distance deep into stoppage time. The first eight finishers in the expanded 16-team league phase will progress to the knockout rounds in March, with the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final to be played in Saudi Arabia in April and May.

item.title: WNBA's influence felt as Women's World Cup vows schedule changes
item.description: The WNBA season resumes on Thursday after the league’s growing influence was felt at the FIBA Women’s World Cup, where a punishing schedule underlined the difficulty of staging major international tournaments without accommodating the world’s leading women’s league.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: The WNBA season resumes on Thursday after the league’s growing influence was felt at the FIBA Women’s World Cup, where a punishing schedule underlined the difficulty of staging major international tournaments without accommodating the world’s leading women’s league. The WNBA paused its season for the tournament, frustrating some fans, while FIBA has already said the 2030 World Cup will be staged later in the year, another sign that the league’s growing power is reshaping the global basketball calendar. "We are pleased that the collaboration between global women’s basketball stakeholders, and adjustments we are seeing in the global women’s basketball calendar, more easily allow players to fulfill both WNBA and international team commitments," a WNBA spokesperson told Reuters. The season restarts only four days after Sunday’s final, in which the United States beat France 97-79. Many players had rushed from their WNBA teams to join their national squads in Berlin, leaving little time to prepare and adding to fatigue as the tournament progressed. FIBA Secretary General Andreas Zagklis acknowledged concerns over the compressed schedule. "We had to have a schedule here that will not be repeated, I can confirm that," Zagklis told reporters on Sunday, promising there would be no back-to-back games at the 2030 tournament in Tokyo. "I'm still convinced we did the best we could in the circumstances we had... while admitting that it was not perfect." Seventy current and former WNBA players went to compete in Berlin, compared with about 30 active players at the tournament four years ago, illustrating the league’s increasingly central role in the international game. 'THE MOST TALENTED LEAGUE IN THE WORLD' The WNBA season, which runs from spring to early autumn, does not align with the traditional international basketball calendar. But amid an increasingly congested schedule, the league has found itself at the head of the table with increasing power and influence. "To perform well in FIBA, (teams) need the WNBA players,” said Jerica Williams, a WNBA scout who has consulted for multiple front offices around the league. “It is without a doubt the most talented league in the world." The WNBA said FIBA’s calendar change would reduce disruption for players balancing club and international commitments. "The FIBA Women’s World Cup, like the Summer Olympics, is important for the growth of women’s basketball both in the US and globally given the global stage it offers," the spokesperson added. The schedule shift marks the latest development in an ongoing push by the league to ensure their leading players prioritise the WNBA. Players have long supplemented their income by competing overseas during the off-season, often enduring gruelling year-round schedules with little opportunity to rest. Some overseas competitions also overlapped with the start of WNBA training camps. Prioritization rules that came into effect three years ago required veteran players to report to their WNBA teams before training camp or by May 1, even if they had to depart from their overseas obligations early. NEW OFF-SEASON ENTERPRISES The rules were an early demonstration of the WNBA’s growing clout during a period of rapid expansion, with [USN:L8N3SX14F TEXT:"new teams"] joining amid [USN:L4N3SC1HB TEXT:"viewership growth"] and the popularity of bankable stars such as Indiana Fever's sharpshooter Caitlin Clark. International sales of WNBA merchandise have exploded - up by 200% over the past three years with merchandise shipped to more than 50 countries outside the U.S. in 2026 alone. Improved salaries in the league's [USN:KBN3Q62D2 TEXT:"latest CBA"], plus the addition of appealing new off-season enterprises like Unrivaled, a three-on-three off-season league that launched in North America in 2025 to extraordinary interest from the top talent in the WNBA, have further tipped the scales in the WNBA's favour. "Over time you're going to see less of the superstars playing in every single qualifier, every single tournament," said Alex Bazzell, the president and CEO of Unrivaled. Unrivaled lured players with its supersized paychecks and a lighter workload - teams play just 14 games apiece - fitting more comfortably into the WNBA offseason. After its latest funding round, the league was valued at $650 million in August. "We had to see which way the schedule was trending when we started out in this," said Bazzell. "Certainly, there were a lot more months of the offseason when we first started, but I think we positioned ourselves and that's why you see these players who are now kind of all flocking to us, those that hadn't played in the offseason before and then those who have obviously traditionally played overseas."

item.title: Suposto pagamento de Vorcaro por faixa preta no jiu-jítsu é sátira
item.description: Posts nas redes sociais tratam como se fosse verdadeira uma sátira que diz que Daniel Vorcaro, ex-dono do liquidado Banco Master, ofereceu R$300 mil a um professor de jiu-jítsu para comprar uma faixa preta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Posts nas redes sociais tratam como se fosse verdadeira uma sátira que diz que Daniel Vorcaro, ex-dono do liquidado Banco Master, ofereceu R$300 mil a um professor de jiu-jítsu para comprar uma faixa preta. “Investigação: Professor de jiu-jítsu de Recife recebe proposta de R$300 mil para vender faixa preta, segundo PF. Troca de mensagens foi encontrada pela Polícia Federal durante investigações sobre o caso. Daniel Vorcaro teria oferecido alta quantia em troca de promoção na arte suave”, afirmam as publicações , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. O conteúdo também reproduz a marca do site Metrópoles e uma suposta troca de mensagens em que o banqueiro faz a oferta e o professor a recusa. A Reuters identificou que o conteúdo teve origem no perfil do lutador de jiu-jítsu Pedro Bisneto no Instagram , no dia 4 de setembro, mas com uma imagem diferente, que trazia a sua foto de quimono. “Esta é uma montagem fictícia inspirada no recente escândalo bancário brasileiro e nas denúncias envolvendo bilhões de reais e figuras políticas de destaque. A conversa aqui apresentada foi totalmente inventada para fins de humor. Daniel Vorcaro nunca me ofereceu dinheiro por uma faixa preta”, escreveu na legenda. No dia seguinte, outro lutador de jiu-jítsu, Salomão Azevedo, compartilhou a mesma montagem , mas substituindo a imagem de Bisneto por uma foto sua. Foi essa versão da sátira que viralizou. Por WhatsApp , Azevedo confirmou à Reuters que “foi uma brincadeira” e que a postagem diz que se trata de IA. Bisneto não respondeu ao contato da Reuters. Além disso, a suposta notícia não consta no site do Metrópoles . O veículo disse à Reuters por e-mail que “repudia o uso indevido de sua marca por pessoas que se apropriam de seu logotipo e de sua credibilidade para disseminar informações falsas e enganar o público”. “O responsável pela publicação, bem como a plataforma em que o conteúdo foi divulgado, serão devidamente notificados para a imediata remoção do material, sem prejuízo da adoção das medidas legais cabíveis”, acrescentou. O alegado diálogo também não aparece nas mensagens de Vorcaro que se tornaram públicas e foram consultadas pela reportagem. Procurada por e-mail para comentar o post, a defesa de Vorcaro não enviou resposta até o momento. VEREDICTO Sátira. A alegação de que Vorcaro ofereceu R$300 mil para comprar uma faixa preta de jiu-jítsu teve origem em posts humorísticos. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
item.description: Spain's data protection watchdog said it has received the first reported notification of a personal data breach allegedly carried out by an artificial intelligence agent, a case that suggests autonomous systems are beginning to play a direct role in cyberattacks.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spain's data protection watchdog said it has received the first reported notification of a personal data breach allegedly carried out by an artificial intelligence agent, a case that suggests autonomous systems are beginning to play a direct role in cyberattacks. The Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) said on Monday in a blog on its website that the incident involved an AI agent using a widely known large language model to identify vulnerabilities, gain access to a system and subsequently modify personal data and access invoices. The agency said that the alleged breach was reported to it by the affected organization and the information remains under review, adding the use of a particular AI model did not mean either the model itself or its provider's infrastructure was compromised, nor that the technology was developed for malicious purposes. AEPD did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment, nor identify the large language model or the organization targeted by the breach. The agency said the case was relevant because a third party allegedly used an AI agent to carry out multiple stages of an attack with limited human intervention, highlighting the growing role of autonomous systems in cybersecurity incidents. The incident comes as regulators and cybersecurity authorities across the United States and Europe increase scrutiny of the risks posed by increasingly capable AI systems, even as businesses adopt the technology at a rapid pace. PRIORITISING PUBLIC SAFETY Spain [USN:L8N41P1NE TEXT:"has positioned itself"] as one of Europe's most vocal advocates of a "trustworthy AI" model that protects privacy, democracy, minors and public safety rather than prioritising speed or profit for the tech industry. While a single case is insufficient to establish a broader trend, the notification suggests that AI-assisted attacks are moving beyond the theoretical stage and are beginning to affect real-world processing of personal data, AEPD added. According to the notification submitted by the affected organisation, the agent successfully logged into the system before autonomously searching for application weaknesses. After identifying a vulnerability, it was able to alter personal information and view billing records. The Spanish watchdog did not say when it would finish reviewing the reported breach. The agency said AI does not create new threats. However, it increases the speed, scale and adaptability of existing malicious techniques, reducing the time available to detect and contain them. Controllers, processors and data protection officers must prepare for a scenario in which the speed of attacks will continue to increase, the agency added.

item.title: Argentina submits 2027 budget bill to Congress, foresees 4% GDP growth
item.description: Argentina's government presented its 2027 budget proposal to Congress on Tuesday, laying out President Javier Milei's economic projections and spending priorities ahead of a presidential election next year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina's government presented its 2027 budget proposal to Congress on Tuesday, laying out President Javier Milei's economic projections and spending priorities ahead of a presidential election next year. According to the bill, the government forecasts GDP growth of 4% in 2027 from an expected 3% this year, and expects Argentina to record a trade surplus of over $15 billion next year. Annual inflation is projected at 18%, compared with 29% this year. Argentina will hold presidential elections in October 2027, and Milei is widely expected to seek re-election. The budget is expected to serve as the administration's final full-year fiscal plan before the vote, and is likely to operate as a roadmap for economic and political priorities heading into the campaign. The bill now moves to the budget committee, then to Congress. Argentina has operated for extended periods without an approved budget, with the previous year’s rolled over, which is the fallback if the process fails to secure approval. Milei has previously said that Argentina should increase defense spending as part of a broader effort to strengthen its sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands, known in Argentina as the Malvinas. Milei has adopted a harder line on Argentina's claim to the Falkland Islands, that Argentina calls the Malvinas after signals from U.S. President Donald Trump that Washington's longstanding neutrality on the dispute could soften. Since taking office in late 2023, Milei has centered his economic program on spending cuts and eliminating the fiscal deficit through austerity measures that have sharply reduced public expenditure, making any proposed increase in areas such as defense particularly notable, analysts said.

item.title: Messi invited by Argentina to make farewell appearance following international retirement
item.description: Lionel Messi has been invited by Argentina to make a farewell appearance in a home friendly in October following his international retirement, Argentine Football Association (AFA) president Claudio Tapia confirmed on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lionel Messi has been invited by Argentina to make a farewell appearance in a home friendly in October following his international retirement, Argentine Football Association (AFA) president Claudio Tapia confirmed on Tuesday. "We invited the best player in the world to play, the icon of our selection, our captain Lionel Andres Messi, to have a deserved farewell on October 6, here in Argentina," Tapia said on social media. Argentina will play three home friendlies during the September 21-October 6 FIFA international window, their first matches since the World Cup. They will take on Benin in Buenos Aires' Monumental Stadium on October 6, where Messi, who announced his [USN:L6N44S0US TEXT:"retirement from international football"] last month, has been invited to play his farewell match. Argentina will also face Bolivia at Cordoba's Mario Kempes Stadium on September 30 before moving to Buenos Aires to host Burkina Faso on October 3. The Bolivia match will be played with capacity reduced by 50% as part of [USN:L1N44I0LF TEXT:"FIFA sanctions"] relating to incidents during this year's World Cup. Leandro Paredes, Nahuel Molina and Thiago Almada must serve suspensions of 10, seven and one match respectively for their roles in an altercation during the World Cup final against Spain.

item.title: Wall St fecha em baixa com alta do petróleo e o rendimento dos Treasuries ultrapassando 5%
item.description: Wall Street ampliou sua onda de vendas nesta terça-feira, à medida que o aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA, as crescentes preocupações com a dívida e a alta vertiginosa dos preços do petróleo mantiveram os compradores à margem do mercado.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street ampliou sua onda de vendas nesta terça-feira, à medida que o aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA, as crescentes preocupações com a dívida e a alta vertiginosa dos preços do petróleo mantiveram os compradores à margem do mercado. Os três principais índices acionários dos EUA ampliaram as perdas registradas na segunda-feira, à medida que um clima generalizado de aversão ao risco pesou sobre quase todos os setores, com exceção do de energia (.SPNY) . Esse setor se beneficiou da escalada das hostilidades no Oriente Médio, que incluiu novos ataques à infraestrutura energética da Arábia Saudita. “Considerando o aumento dos preços dos combustíveis, especialmente do diesel, a perspectiva quase certa de alta nas taxas a partir de amanhã e as preocupações com uma possível desaceleração no ecossistema da IA, por que entrar no mercado de forma agressiva até que parte disso se esclareça?”, disse Peter Tuz, presidente da Chase Investment Counsel em Charlottesville, Virgínia. O Federal Reserve se reuniu para seu encontro de política monetária de dois dias, que deve culminar na quarta-feira com a decisão do banco central sobre as taxas. Com dados econômicos recentes mostrando o mercado de trabalho em bases sólidas, enquanto as pressões sobre os preços da energia relacionadas à guerra estão se transformando em uma inflação mais ampla e sistêmica, espera-se que o banco central implemente um aumento de 25 pontos-base na taxa básica — seu primeiro aumento dos juros em mais de três anos. Na esteira dos dados de inflação elevados da semana passada e do salto de quase 25% nos preços do petróleo bruto dos EUA nas últimas duas semanas, os mercados financeiros precificaram uma probabilidade de 94,5% de um aumento da taxa na quarta-feira, ante 33,1% há um mês, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. Tuz acrescentou que, embora os mercados venham a conhecer a decisão do Fed na quarta-feira, “o conflito no Oriente Médio é uma incógnita quanto ao tempo que pode durar”. Os contratos futuros do West Texas Intermediate (WTI) e do Brent com vencimento mais próximo fecharam em alta de 4,4% e 2,9%, respectivamente, enquanto os futuros do diesel fecharam em nível recorde. “Provavelmente não será um aumento pontual, mas uma série de aumentos nas taxas”, disse Paul Nolte, consultor sênior de patrimônio e estrategista de mercado da Murphy & Sylvest em Elmhurst, Illinois. “Isso dependerá do petróleo; essa é realmente a fonte da inflação e está começando a se espalhar para outras partes do mercado.” À medida que aumentaram as apostas no aumento das taxas, os rendimentos dos títulos globais retomaram sua trajetória de alta, com os rendimentos de referência dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA ultrapassando 5% e atingindo o nível mais alto desde 2007. O aumento das taxas de juros está intensificando a pressão sobre tomadores de empréstimos altamente endividados, incluindo empresas que apostaram pesadamente na IA. Essas preocupações agravaram os temores crescentes sobre o potencial destrutivo da IA e a oposição cada vez maior à construção de data centers, que chegaram ao auge na segunda-feira e arrastaram para baixo o índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) . O índice de chips, que ajudou a impulsionar ganhos mais amplos no mercado de ações este ano, não se recuperou significativamente da queda de segunda-feira, registrando um ganho modesto de 0,4%. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,63%, para 52.093,11 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,45%, para 7.585,73 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,78%, para 25.981,57 pontos. Entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500, as ações do setor de bens de consumo discricionário (.SPLRCD) registraram as maiores quedas em termos percentuais, enquanto o setor de energia, impulsionado pela alta do petróleo bruto, avançou 2,3%. A Dave & Buster’s (PLAY.O) despencou 19% após a empresa ter ficado aquém das expectativas de receita no segundo trimestre. A Waystar (WAY.O) saltou 7,1% depois que a Reuters informou que a empresa de software para o setor de saúde está explorando opções, incluindo uma possível venda. A desvalorização das ações de bitcoin foi agravada pelo fato de o Senado dos EUA não ter avançado com uma legislação abrangente sobre criptomoedas, o que representou um golpe para as empresas de ativos digitais. As empresas de criptomoedas Coinbase (COIN.O) e Strategy (MSTR.O) caíram 10,1% e 5,4%, respectivamente.

item.title: Ed Sheeran says dropping Macklemore from US tour was not his decision
item.description: Pop star Ed Sheeran said on Tuesday dropping American rapper Macklemore from his U.S. tour was not Sheeran's decision but that of the tour's promoter, even as Sheeran distinguished his political approach from Macklemore's.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Pop star Ed Sheeran said on Tuesday [USN:L4N4561KP TEXT:"dropping American rapper Macklemore"] from his U.S. tour was not Sheeran's decision but that of the tour's promoter, even as Sheeran distinguished his political approach from Macklemore's. Macklemore was dropped from Sheeran's U.S. tour after his pro-Palestinian comments and "Free Palestine" remarks during a September 4 concert in New Jersey. "Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter's decision, it was not mine," Sheeran said on Instagram. Messina Touring Group, promoter of the U.S. leg of Sheeran's Loop Tour, told Rolling Stone that venue owners on upcoming U.S. tour dates notified the promoters they will not allow a concert to take place with Macklemore in the lineup. Macklemore has long been pro-Palestinian and critical of Israel's assault on Gaza and its [USN:L6N42H0E8 TEXT:"occupation of the West Bank"]. In 2024, Macklemore released [USN:W1N3GH034 TEXT:"Hind's Hall"], a protest anthem in solidarity with pro-Palestinian demonstrators and in memory of five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab who was killed by Israeli troops in Gaza. Sheeran said he respected Macklemore's "strength of purpose to stand up and shout for what he believes" but that Sheeran's approach was to not use his "professional platform for politics." Sheeran said venues for upcoming tour dates warned they would pull the shows over Macklemore. Macklemore received support from pro-Palestinian advocacy groups and politicians. Pro-Israeli groups and American singer Pink, who is Jewish, have criticized him, saying such comments at a concert risk compromising the safety of Jewish and pro-Israeli people at such events. They also point to a 2014 costume that Macklemore wore which included a black wig, beard and a fake hooked nose, which critics said tapped into antisemitic stereotypes. Macklemore subsequently apologized for that costume. On Monday, Macklemore denied that his concert comments were antisemitic, saying conflating antisemitism with criticism of Israel's actions aims to avoid Israeli accountability.

item.title: Petrobras assegura alta do Ibovespa em pregão com STF no foco antes de Fed e Copom
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta terça-feira, sustentado principalmente pelas ações da Petrobras , com o preço do barril do petróleo avançando quase 3% no mercado internacional.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta terça-feira, sustentado principalmente pelas ações da Petrobras (PETR3.SA) , com o preço do barril do petróleo avançando quase 3% no mercado internacional. Investidores também voltaram as atenções para audiência no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) sobre petição referente a mensagens trocadas pelo ministro da corte Alexandre de Moraes e o ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) subiu 0,54%, a 186.502,64 pontos, após duas quedas seguidas. Na máxima do dia, chegou a 187.650,53 pontos. Na mínima, cedeu a 185.055,57. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$22 bilhões, em sessão também de expectativa para decisões de juros na quarta-feira nos Estados Unidos e no Brasil. O barril de petróleo Brent fechou em alta de 2,9%, a US$108,75, após notícias de que carregamentos no porto de Yanbu, na Arábia Saudita, no Mar Vermelho, haviam sido suspensos e que a Líbia interrompeu operações em três campos. Em Nova York, o S&P 500 (.SPX) recuou 0,45%, em sessão também marcada pelo avanço nos rendimentos dos Treasuries, com receios envolvendo IA ainda minando a confiança dos investidores, em véspera de decisão de política monetária nos Estados Unidos. A agenda de "super quarta-feira" também inclui decisão de juros no Brasil, com economistas [USN:L6N4560N2 TEXT:"estimando"] um corte na taxa Selic para 13,75% ao ano e atentos a eventuais sinais sobre os próximos passos do Copom. Nesta terça-feira, porém, o STF concentrou as atenções, em uma sessão marcada por trocas de acusações e discussões entre os ministros da corte. A petição em análise no plenário da corte nesta terça-feira diz respeito a um relatório divulgado pelo ministro André Mendonça, que aponta mensagens entre Moraes e Vorcaro, ex-banqueiro preso acusado de fraudes financeiras e outros crimes. A bolsa fechou com os ministros votando para unificar os casos envolvendo os ministros Moraes e Mendonça e designar novo relator. A petição sobre Mendonça, que estava prevista para ser analisada no dia 23, diz respeito à alegação de Moraes de que o colega teria cometido abuso de poder e crime de responsabilidade no caso Master. De acordo com o Willian Queiroz, sócio e advisor da Blue3 Investimentos, a alta da Petrobras com o aumento dos preços do petróleo no exterior foi o principal "driver" do Ibovespa, mas o destaque na pauta do dia foi a sessão extraordinária no STF. Ele afirmou que se trata de um assunto que pode fazer preço no cenário eleitoral. "Sem dúvidas, o mercado está tenso", acrescentou o especialista em investimentos e sócio-fundador da Boa Brasil Capital, Marcos Bassani, afirmando que o julgamento gera incerteza política e traz maior volatilidade. "Ter o Supremo com foco de eventuais corrupções gera incertezas em relação ao investidor nacional e estrangeiro, abrindo margem para risco/Brasil." O dia também contou com [USN:S0N44O038 TEXT:"pesquisa CNT/MDA"] divulgada nesta terça-feira mostrando o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) à frente do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) em um eventual segundo turno entre ambos. De acordo com o levantamento, no segundo turno, Lula lidera com 47,3%, ante 48% na pesquisa anterior, ao passo que Flávio soma 40%, ante 39%. A margem de erro é de 2,2 pontos percentuais. Outros levantamentos vinham mostrando empate técnico. Dados da B3 sobre a participação de estrangeiros na bolsa paulista mostraram a primeira sessão com saldo negativo no mês, no último dia 11. Ainda assim, setembro acumula uma entrada líquida de R$7,3 bilhões. Até o dia 10, eram R$7,4 bilhões. Pesquisa do Bank of America com gestores na América Latina mostrou recuperação no sentimento de investidores em setembro, com 73% dos participantes enxergando o Ibovespa acima de 180 mil no fim do ano, de 34% no levantamento de agosto. Além disso, 46% acreditam que o índice poderá atingir 200 mil pontos ou mais, um cenário que não foi apontado por nenhum participante na pesquisa anterior. A incerteza eleitoral, porém, continua presente. Apenas 30% dos entrevistados afirmaram que estariam dispostos a aumentar sua exposição a ações nos níveis atuais antes das eleições. Os demais prefeririam ampliar posições apenas em caso de correção dos preços ou aguardar uma definição maior do cenário político, mostrou o levantamento. DESTAQUES PETROBRAS PN avançou 3,09% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) ganhou 3,63%, endossadas pelo movimento do petróleo no exterior, que ajudou também outras petrolíferas na B3. PRIO ON (PRIO3.SA) subiu 2,77% e BRAVA ENERGIA ON (BRAV3.SA) valorizou-se 0,9%. PETRORECONCAVO ON (RECV3.SA) , que não faz mais parte do Ibovespa, fechou estável. ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN subiu 0,76%, abandonando a fraqueza registrada em parte da sessão e descolando do sinal negativo dos bancos do Ibovespa. BRADESCO PN cedeu 0,71%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT caiu 0,99%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) apurou declínio de 0,36% e BTG PACTUAL UNIT terminou em baixa de 0,46%. VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 1,17%, alinhada à fraqueza do setor de mineração no exterior, tendo como pano de fundo o declínio dos futuros do minério de ferro na China. No setor de mineração e siderurgia na B3, GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) subiu 3,15% e USIMINAS PNA avançou 3,27%, enquanto CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) cedeu 2,2% e CSN MINERAÇÃO ON (CMIN3.SA) perdeu 0,96%. AZZAS 2154 ON (AZZA3.SA) caiu 2,98%, ampliando a correção após um começo de mês mais positivo na esteira do anúncio de [USN:L6N44U12G TEXT:"reorganização"] societária pela companhia. Na máxima intradia do mês, chegou a R$18,28, no dia 8. Nesta sessão, fechou a R$15,30. Apesar do ajustes, ainda soma uma valorização de quase 3% em setembro.

item.title: Trump administration appeals ruling blocking EPA from sending California auto emissions rules to Congress
item.description: The Trump administration on Tuesday appealed a ruling blocking the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency from sending landmark California vehicle emissions rules to the Republican-controlled Congress for a potential fast-track repeal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration on Tuesday appealed a ruling blocking the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency from sending landmark California vehicle emissions rules to the Republican-controlled Congress for a potential fast-track repeal. item.title: Renault y Geely invertirán 319 millones de euros en Brasil, ampliarán su colaboración
item.description: Los fabricantes de automóviles Renault y Geely anunciaron el martes que realizarán una nueva inversión de 319 millones de euros en Brasil, a través de su empresa conjunta, reforzando así su alianza industrial en el mayor mercado de América Latina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los fabricantes de automóviles Renault (RENA.PA) y Geely (0175.HK) anunciaron el martes que realizarán una nueva inversión de 319 millones de euros en Brasil, a través de su empresa conjunta, reforzando así su alianza industrial en el mayor mercado de América Latina. Renault anunció meses atrás la formalización de un acuerdo en Brasil con Geely. La nueva inversión eleva el total de las inversiones de ambas empresas en Brasil a 899 millones de euros entre 2025 y 2027. El acuerdo permite a Geely acceder a una planta y una red de concesionarios ya existentes y ayudará al fabricante francés a aprovechar mejor la capacidad disponible en su planta de montaje y a añadir modelos más grandes a su gama, de acuerdo a Renault. Renault ha señalado que su tecnología híbrida E-Tech 4x4 de combustible flexible entrará en producción en Brasil en 2027 en el marco de un nuevo plan de inversión.

item.title: US nuclear regulator's overhaul of rules to run well into 2027, its chief says
item.description: The U.S. nuclear power regulator's overhaul of rules, part of a push to cut approval times for new reactors to 18 months, will continue well into next year, its chairman told Reuters on Tuesday, as the Trump administration seeks to quadruple the country's nuclear capacity by 2050.
item.dc:creator: Francois Murphy
item.content:encoded: The U.S. nuclear power regulator's overhaul of rules, part of a push to cut approval times for new reactors to 18 months, will continue well into next year, its chairman told Reuters on Tuesday, as the Trump administration seeks to quadruple the country's nuclear capacity by 2050. To help meet power demand surging from electric vehicles, data centers and crypto mining, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission is making a series of changes aimed at streamlining the licensing of new facilities. It has already proposed [USN:L1N43A10D TEXT:"narrowing"] the scope of environmental reviews and changing a rule protecting people from radiation. "I would say well into next year," NRC Chairman Ho Nieh said in an interview on the sidelines of the U.N. nuclear watchdog's General Conference, an annual meeting of member states, when asked how much longer the overhaul would continue. "You're going to see some final rules be published in the Federal Register toward the end of this year, into early next year, and deeper into next calendar year," he added. Further planned changes include a regulatory framework for [USN:L1N44N0RW TEXT:"microreactors"], tiny factory-built nuclear plants that developers say will be easily transported, and which the U.S. Army hopes will one day power remote installations. The NRC is getting closer to its target of approving new facilities within 18 months, but will not do so at any cost, he said. "Those are timelines we are challenging ourselves to meet, but we will not issue a decision if it's not safe. And if it's something that has to take more time, we will take more time to do it. I trust staff to exercise those judgments in doing that," he said. Licensing approvals for new nuclear facilities have previously taken several years. NRC DEFENDS INDEPENDENCE Trump last year signed four executive orders on nuclear power that seek to shorten the approval time. In a report on global nuclear security published on Tuesday, the Nuclear Threat Initiative, a think tank, said the orders had "compromised the political independence and oversight authority" of the NRC by, among other things, requiring changes in regulation to be submitted to the White House for approval. Nieh rejected that assertion. "There is no reduction in our independence. We are part of the federal government. Like all executive branch agencies, we follow the general policies set by the administration," Nieh said. "We make and we own our regulatory decisions, and that hasn't changed. So I know it's provocative to say that the NRC is not independent, but I reject that assertion because I'm in it. I see what's happening."

item.title: Germany, US sign agreement to deepen defense cooperation between industries
item.description: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius signed a letter of intent with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday aimed at deepening cooperation between weapons makers in both countries at a time when defense stocks have dwindled.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius signed a letter of intent with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday aimed at deepening cooperation between weapons makers in both countries at a time when defense stocks have dwindled. Pistorius told reporters that he had a good discussion with Hegseth, noting that details of the defense cooperation - and a planned German purchase of Tomahawk cruise missiles - still needed to be worked out. Germany and the United States were "on the same page" regarding security concerns in Europe, and U.S. officials understood and appreciated Germany's accelerated efforts to increase defense spending and troops, Pistorius said. The agreement was signed during the meeting, an embassy spokesman said. Pistorius stressed that the weapons purchase would not make Germany too dependent on the United States, but would help achieve a better balance between the two allies, he said. "It's about coming closer together in those areas in which we need each other, and to make clear that we can benefit from each other when it comes to increased capacities of our defense industry," he said. Pistorius said he did not hear any critiques about Germany's actions or new demands, and the discussion was friendly and relaxed.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno argentino, liderado por el libertario Javier Milei, estima que su economía crecerá un 4% en 2027, contra un avance del 3% en 2026, según el proyecto de ley de presupuesto presentado este martes al Congreso. La inflación registrará una variación interanual del 18%, frente al 29% del año en curso, señaló. Según una síntesis distribuida oficialmente, la balanza comercial de la tercera economía de América Latina arrojaría un superávit de 15.560 millones de dólares el año próximo, comparados con el saldo positivo de 16.951 millones del 2026. El proyecto defiende el 'déficit cero' como eje central en la campaña de Milei, quien buscará su reelección en los comicios presidenciales de 2027.

item.title: UMG sues DistroKid for allegedly distributing AI 'slop' music
item.description: Universal Music Group sued DistroKid in Delaware federal court on Tuesday, accusing the online music distributor of infringing the label's copyrights and "flooding platforms with AI-generated 'slop' that siphons revenue and listeners from the legitimate artists."
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) sued DistroKid in Delaware federal court on Tuesday, accusing the online music distributor of infringing the label's copyrights and "flooding platforms with AI-generated 'slop' that siphons revenue and listeners from the legitimate artists." The lawsuit accused DistroKid of bolstering its streaming numbers and revenue with mass-uploaded, bot-generated "spam" music as well as "thousands" of unlicensed versions of UMG recordings. "At scale, DistroKid’s conduct makes it more difficult for working and emerging artists to be discovered and compensated for their creative labor," the complaint said. Spokespeople for DistroKid did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the lawsuit. DistroKid is a distribution service that allows recording artists to upload music across online stores and streaming platforms. Spotify, which is not named in the lawsuit, [USN:KCN1MR383 TEXT:"bought"] a minority stake in the company in 2018. UMG's lawsuit said that a "massive portion" of DistroKid's music is either AI "slop" or copyright-infringing despite the distributor's assurances otherwise. In addition to alleged AI "slop," the label accused DistroKid of releasing thousands of tracks that are "remixed or speed-altered" UMG recordings, illegally sample UMG music, or otherwise violate its rights. UMG said DistroKid violated its rights in at least 1,000 recordings by popular artists including, The Beatles, Drake, Lady Gaga and Rihanna. It asked the court for monetary damages and an order blocking DistroKid's alleged misconduct. The complaint also said that DistroKid created many of its AI tracks using the AI music generator Suno. UMG has [USN:L1N3IM0QK TEXT:"separately sued Suno"] for allegedly misusing its music for AI training. The case is UMG Recordings Inc v. DistroKid LLC, U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware, No. 1:26-cv-01156. For UMG: Glenn Pomerantz of Munger, Tolles & Olson For DistroKid: attorney information not yet available Read more: [USN:L1N3IM0QK TEXT:"Music labels sue AI companies Suno, Udio for US copyright infringement"]

item.title: Cowboys sign RB Tyler Goodson from Falcons' practice squad
item.description: The Dallas Cowboys signed running back Tyler Goodson off the Atlanta Falcons' practice squad on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Dallas Cowboys signed running back Tyler Goodson off the Atlanta Falcons' practice squad on Tuesday. The Cowboys cleared room on the 53-man active roster by waiving fellow running back Israel Abanikanda. The move comes after running back Malik Davis landed on injured reserve Saturday following a hip injury. Goodson, 25, rushed 54 times for 264 yards and one TD and caught 19 passes for 103 yards and one TD in 33 games (one start) with the Indianapolis Colts from 2023-25 after going undrafted out of Iowa. Abanikanda, 23, was a fifth-round pick by the New York Jets in 2023. He has spent time with the San Francisco 49ers, Green Bay Packers and Cowboys but has not played in a game since the 2023 season. Cowboys starter Javonte Williams rushed 12 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught five passes for 31 yards and another score in Sunday night's season-opening road loss to the New York Giants. Dallas (0-1) hosts the Washington Commander (0-1) on Sunday afternoon. --Field Level Media

item.title: Soja encerra em alta em Chicago, com impulso do farelo após dados de processamento nos EUA
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) encerraram em alta nesta terça-feira, com os contratos futuros de farelo de soja avançando mais de 2% depois que um relatório mensal do setor mostrou um ritmo de esmagamento menor do que o esperado em agosto, segundo operadores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) encerraram em alta nesta terça-feira, com os contratos futuros de farelo de soja avançando mais de 2% depois que um relatório mensal do setor mostrou um ritmo de esmagamento menor do que o esperado em agosto, segundo operadores. Um salto nos preços do petróleo , associado a interrupções no abastecimento no Oriente Médio, deu apoio adicional à soja e ao milho, ambos utilizados na produção de biocombustíveis. A soja fechou com alta de 14,50 centavos, ou 1,1%, a US$13,1875 por bushel. O milho terminou em alta de 0,5%, a US$ 5,3575 o bushel. O contrato de farelo de soja dezembro encerrou com alta de US$9,20, ou 2,6%, a US$365,40 por tonelada. Todos os meses, exceto o mais ativo, atingiram máximas históricas durante a vigência do contrato. A Associação Nacional de Processadores de Oleaginosas informou que seus membros moeram [USN:L6N457142 TEXT:"205,456"] milhões de bushels de soja em agosto, a menor marca em 11 meses, e que os estoques de óleo de soja caíram para o nível mais baixo desde novembro de 2024. A estatal Conab previu a produção de soja do Brasil para a safra 2026/27 em 181,64 milhões de toneladas métricas, um aumento de 0,7% em relação ao ano anterior, mas abaixo da previsão atual do Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA para o Brasil, de 186 milhões de toneladas. Os contratos futuros de trigo fecharam em alta, recuperando-se das quedas de segunda-feira, à medida que as esperanças de uma desescalada militar na região de exportação de grãos do Mar Negro diminuíam em meio a novos ataques à infraestrutura, segundo operadores. Os preços tinham caído no dia anterior após um anúncio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, de que a Ucrânia e a Rússia haviam concordado em suspender os ataques, embora nenhum dos lados tenha confirmado tal acordo. O trigo em Chicago fechou em alta de 6,5 centavos nesta terça-feira, cotado a US$7,285 por bushel. (Reportagem de Julie Ingwersen)
